in_marathi.name: Shaileshkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaileshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shaileshkumar is a name of Hindu origin which means 'Mountain Lord'. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Shailesh' which means mountain and 'Kumar' which means young boy or prince.
